payload.question: Does the council answer complaints when it says it will?
payload.label: Complaints answered within the council's own deadline, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council's own commentary: "We have exceeded our target again this quarter with 84% which is a positive start to the year. Our performance has remained consistent for the past four quarters which demonstrates improvements to the process and reporting have had a positive impact. Communities & housing: 84%. Development & city services: 84%. Resources: 85%." The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The council sets its own deadline for replying to a complaint — its note on method says within 10 days — and aims to meet it 80% of the time. In the first quarter of 2025/26 it met it 84% of the time. This measures whether a complaint got an answer in time, not whether the answer was any good.
